albums.title: Group 13 & Room 304 Brotherhood
albums.description: The iconic lawn formation where Group 13 classmates formed the numeral "13" and arranged transparent college bags into "NDC 19".
albums.story: Standing together on the green field of Notre Dame College, Batch '19 Group 13 formed the iconic numeral 13 with matching transparent bags spelling 'NDC 19' — an everlasting symbol of collegiate discipline, unity, and lifelong brotherhood.

albums.title: 2018 Student Road Safety Movement
albums.description: Historic moments when Notre Dame College students mobilized from Arambagh to Shapla Chottor demanding transport reform and creating the emergency lane.
albums.story: Thousands of collegiate students peacefully mobilized across Motijheel, creating Bangladesh's first spontaneous Emergency Lanes for ambulances and verifying driver licenses.
